## English

FluentRead 0.0.41 adds reading shortcuts for academic papers, improves image and PDF translation, and adds an optional local speech recognition engine for supported X videos.

### Webpages and academic papers

- Open an arXiv paper in bilingual mode from its abstract page. FluentRead opens the matching official HTML version and preserves the table of contents, formulas, and citations. Papers with only a PDF can open in the document reader.
- Start bilingual reading on PubMed Central full-text pages. Open papers from Hugging Face Papers, ACL Anthology, CVF Open Access, and NeurIPS Proceedings in the PDF reader.
- Translate explicitly selected text in editable fields. The translation card stays clear of the full selection, including selections that span several lines.
- Fixed article detection on Englio, missed paragraphs in IntelliJ IDEA release notes, and hover translation on GitHub README content that reloads in place.

### Images and documents

- Enlarged image previews reuse the translated image. Translation stays aligned while the image scrolls and clears when the preview closes.
- Improved PDF text extraction and translation placement in illustrated cards. Labels embedded in illustrations are preserved.
- PDF export now shortens the last continuation page to fit its text and adds a link back to the corresponding original page.
- SRT, VTT, and ASS translation can use nearby cues as context with compatible AI services while retaining the original timestamps and file structure.

### Video subtitles and learning

- Added optional local Qwen3 ASR for X videos with accessible audio. It requires a separately running service on the same device. In-browser Whisper remains the default.
- Added subtitle outline and background controls. The player shortcut stays available after you turn subtitles off, so you can turn them back on from the player.
- Video learning uses local sentence rules to combine or split subtitle cues. Reduced the work done to update subtitles and player controls.
- Fixed a conflict between FluentRead's reading progress controls and scroll-wheel volume in Bilibili fullscreen playback.

### Translation services and controls

- Remove unused services from your active list and restore them from the service catalog. Added Cheaper Inference and cheapaimodel.
- The translation sidebar shows each service's model, result, and copy action in its own card. Feature-specific service settings open expanded by default.
- Press Esc to step back through service menus. The settings sidebar is more compact, and the floating translation button now has separate resting and hover margins.
- Restored the Safari toolbar popup size and improved emoji preservation in single-line translations with SiliconFlow Hunyuan-MT-7B.
- Fixed a Firefox startup Content Security Policy error from a dependency's dynamic-code check.

detail.readme:
# FluentRead **Closer languages. A bigger world.** An open-source browser extension for bilingual translation. [Install](#installation) · [Website](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/) · [User guide](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/guide/) · [Sponsorship](#sponsorship) · [Privacy policy](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/guide/privacy) · [简体中文](./misc/README_ZH.md) · [LINUX DO Community](https://linux.do) · [GPL-3.0](./LICENSE)
FluentRead displays translations alongside the original webpage and provides selection translation, AI reading assistance, image and document translation, and bilingual video subtitles. Its reading card provides contextual explanations and follow-up questions.
[![FluentRead introduction video](./docs/public/videos/fluentread-promo-en-poster.webp)](https://read.thinkstu.com/videos/fluentread-promo-en.mp4) [▶ Watch the 56-second introduction](https://read.thinkstu.com/videos/fluentread-promo-en.mp4) For a closer look, [watch the full official introduction (4+ minutes, in Chinese on Bilibili)](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1qhHJ6uEiF/).
[![FluentRead bilingual webpage translation](./docs/public/screenshots/en/translation.webp)](./docs/public/screenshots/en/translation.webp) ## Features | Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | Webpage translation | Bilingual page translation, hover and selection translation, original-text restoration, and automatic translation rules. | | AI reading card | Meaning, sentence analysis, usage explanations, and practice, with paragraph context and follow-up questions. | | Learning center | Save words, phrases, and sentences with their original context for study and review. | | Image and area translation | Recognize text in webpage images or selected screen areas and display translations that can be copied. | | Document translation | Read PDF, ePub, DOCX, and other supported formats in two languages, edit translations, and export files. | | Video subtitles | Bilingual subtitles on YouTube and X; supported X videos can also use local AI transcription. | | Services and settings | Free translation services, DeepL, AI providers, and local Ollama models, with glossaries, translation styles, shortcuts, and menu layout settings. | See the [user guide](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/guide/) for instructions and supported formats. AI explanations require a configured AI service. Third-party pricing and availability depend on the provider. ## Installation [Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/djnlaiohfaaifbibleebjggkghlmcpcj) · [Edge](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/kakgmllfpjldjhcnkghpplmlbnmcoflp) · [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/%E6%B5%81%E7%95%85%E9%98%85%E8%AF%BB/) · [Userscript](https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/482986) 1. Install the extension and refresh the webpage. 2. Open FluentRead and select a target language. The source language defaults to automatic detection and can also be selected manually. 3. Choose “Translate page.” Enable selection translation and other tools in settings as needed. Store updates may arrive at different times. The userscript provides core webpage translation features. See the [installation guide](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/guide/getting-started) for browser and feature availability. ## Sponsorship The project is currently funded mainly out of pocket, with a few hundred US dollars spent each month on maintenance. We believe FluentRead can make the world a little better. Thank you to [**bilibili Index-Translate**](https://index-translate.bilibili.com/) for becoming FluentRead’s first sponsor. [Become a sponsor](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/guide/support#sponsorship) · [Email us](mailto:a1914493943@gmail.com?subject=FluentRead%20sponsorship) · [Add on WeChat](https://read.thinkstu.com/support/wechat-contact.jpg) ## Local development Use the Node.js version in `.nvmrc` to match CI. Run pnpm through Corepack to use the version pinned in `package.json` even when your shell has an older global pnpm. ```sh nvm install corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile ``` - `corepack pnpm dev` starts local development. - `corepack pnpm zip` builds and packages the Chrome extension. [Other browsers](./docs/maintainers/releases.md#本地打包) · [Firefox source review](./scripts/amo/README.md) ## Contributing Report bugs and propose changes through [Issues](https://github.com/FluentRead/FluentRead/issues). Pull requests for code, documentation, interface translations, and [website adaptation](./docs/contributing/site-adaptation.md) are welcome. ## Support FluentRead is an open-source project whose continued development is made possible by the generous support of its community. Voluntary contributions are welcome through either service.

## Acknowledgments FluentRead grows alongside a vibrant open-source community. We are grateful to the following projects and their contributors for their openness and generosity: - [Read Frog](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog) - [KISS Translator](https://github.com/fishjar/kiss-translator) - [Duo Translator](https://github.com/linuxscreen/duo-translator) - [InfoLens](https://github.com/dqy08/InfoLens) — Smart Highlighting is inspired by its surprisal heatmap idea (Apache-2.0)



Thank you to everyone who has contributed to FluentRead, including the many we couldn't name here, and to every user for embracing a product that is still far from perfect. We hope to keep building together with you, and to bring a little more good into the world. ## License and privacy FluentRead is released under [GPL-3.0](./LICENSE). See [third-party notices](./public/third-party-notices/) for component attribution and licenses. Settings and learning records stay local by default; cloud translation uses your selected provider. Optional cloud configuration backup supports Google Drive and [WebDAV](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/guide/webdav), including service credentials while excluding wordbooks, conversations, and usage statistics. See the [privacy policy](https://read.thinkstu.com/en/guide/privacy) for permissions, encryption, and deletion details.
